extraction_notes.note: Appendix A is opened by a custom \appsection macro (\section*), which latex_facts does not report as a heading, so the appendix nodes carry the section '5 Conclusions'.

Flow diagrams (CD diagram and a 7x7 arrow grid) are unnumbered displays; kept inside the claim and example that present them.
Numbered equations called 'the identity' / 'well-known trigonometric identities' retyped as external theorems; the derived (trig2) stays an equation.
The section-4 derivation of ln g_A and ln g_B interleaves argument and results in running prose; split into localisation proofs and the formula claims at the sentences that state the formulae.

These are related to the symmetries 
$L(\theta)=L(-\theta)$, $x_a=x_{m+1-a}$, $y_a=y_{m-a}$
of $L(\theta)$ and its plateau values, and, more precisely, to
the following symmetries of the boundary condition combinations 
given in (\ref{gident}):
\begin{align}
[x_a,y_b]&= [x_{m+1-a},y_{m-b}] &
\overline{[x_a,y_b]}&=
[x_{m+1-a},y_{b}]= [x_{a},y_{m-b}] \nonumber\\[3pt]
[x_p,x_q]&= [x_{m+1-p},x_{m+1-q}]&
\overline{[x_p,x_q]}&=
[x_{m+1-p},x_{q}]= [x_{p},x_{m+1-q}] \label{spinflip} \\[3pt]
[y_r,y_s]&= [y_{m-r},y_{m-s}]&
\overline{[y_r,y_s]}&=
[y_{m-r},y_{s}]= [y_{r},y_{m-s}] \nonumber
\end{align}
where the overbar denotes the ${\mathbb Z}_2$ `spin flip' symmetry
mentioned just after (\ref{gmab}), acting on individual Cardy
boundaries as $\overline{(a,b)}=(m{-}a,b)\equiv (a,m{+}1{-}b)$\,.
